results.title: Foreign investors' net selling makes ten stocks, including PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BBRI), PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BBNI) and PT Bumi Resources Tbk (BUMI), top losers as the IHSG falls
results.body: Foreign investors recorded a net sell of Rp559 billion on Friday, 25 September 2026, making ten stocks the largest foreign outflow victims while the IHSG weakened by 56.7 points (0.9%) to 6,241.8 at market close. Net sell in the regular market amounted to Rp440.3 billion and Rp118.7 billion in the negotiation and cash markets, with total transaction value reaching Rp9.3 trillion. The biggest foreign sell-offs were PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BBRI) with Rp62.8 billion, PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BBNI) with Rp37.8 billion, PT Bumi Resources Tbk (BUMI) with Rp29.2 billion, TLKM with Rp112.7 billion and PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk with Rp71 billion. Overall, 122 stocks rose, 587 fell and 254 remained unchanged during the session.

results.title: Foreign investors net sold Rp 4.39 trillion this week, with banks leading the top‑selling stocks
results.body: Foreign investors recorded a net sell of Rp 4.39 trillion across the market during the week ending 26/9/2026, contributing to the IHSG’s 3.09% decline to 6,241.89 points. The ten most net‑sold stocks were PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (BMRI) Rp 1.1 trillion, PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk (BBRI) Rp 676.34 billion, PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BBCA) Rp 597.42 billion, PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk (TLKM) Rp 478.55 billion, PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk (AMMN) Rp 213.79 billion, PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk (ADRO) Rp 159.15 billion, PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk (BBNI) Rp 125.58 billion, PT Bayan Resources Tbk (BYAN) Rp 96.45 billion, PT Barito Pacific Tbk (BRPT) Rp 74.93 billion and PT Indosat Tbk (ISAT) Rp 72.91 billion.

results.title: Indonesia Stock Index (IHSG) Potentially Exposed to Rising U.S. Treasury Yields
results.body: The article discusses the potential impact of rising U.S. Treasury yields on the Indonesia Stock Exchange Composite Index (IHSG). On 24 September, IHSG fell 1.2% to 6,298.61 amid foreign investors' net sell of Rp 1.49 trillion and higher oil prices. Foreign selling targeted shares of big banks BMRI and BBRI and telecom firm TLKM, contributing to the index's weakness. Analysts forecast further testing of support around 6,186-6,200 (or 6,254/6,146) and resistance near 6,400, with the index's direction tied to continued U.S. Treasury yield increases.

results.title: Foreign investors net sold a record Rp 1.49 trillion as the IHSG fell, with PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (BMRI) topping the list of heavily shorted stocks.
results.body: Foreign investors recorded a net sell of Rp 1.49 trillion across the Indonesian market on 24 September 2026, contributing to a 1.20 % decline in the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) to 6,298.60 points. The market saw 462 stocks close lower, total trading volume reach 29.03 billion shares worth Rp 10.82 trillion, and all sector indices weaken, the raw materials sector falling 2.17 % as the most corrected. The ten most heavily shorted stocks were PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (BMRI) with a net sell of Rp 531.94 billion, PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk (BBRI) Rp 133.24 billion, PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk (TLKM) Rp 84.61 billion, PT Aneka Tambang Tbk (ANTM) Rp 51.65 billion, PT Darma Henwa Tbk (DEWA) Rp 39.70 billion, PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk (TPIA) Rp 32.60 billion, PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk (AMMN) Rp 32.03 billion, PT Barito Pacific Tbk (BRPT) Rp 24.71 billion, PT Indosat Tbk (ISAT) Rp 24.02 billion, and PT Indika Energy Tbk (INDY) Rp 17.52 billion.

results.title: IHSG falls 1.20% to 6,298.61; analysts see support test at 6,200‑6,254 on Friday
results.body: The Indonesia Stock Exchange Composite Index (IHSG) closed down 1.20% at 6,298.61 on Thursday amid foreign‑investor selling of about Rp 987 billion, higher oil prices and rising US Treasury yields. Analysts highlighted support levels at 6,254 and 6,146 and resistance at 6,352 and 6,429, while also noting a potential test of the 6,186‑6,200 range with support at 6,200 and resistance at 6,400 on Friday. The index traded below its 5‑day and 100‑day moving averages, with MACD in negative territory and Stochastic RSI in oversold condition. The sell‑off targeted major bank stocks BMRI, BBRI and telecommunications firm TLKM, which were among the shares hit by foreign investors.

results.title: PT Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk (EMTK) strengthens its position in PT Bukalapak.com Tbk (BUKA) and PT Nitrasanata Dharma Tbk (JECX)
results.body: The BEI disclosed on 22 Sep that PT Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk (EMTK) increased its holdings in PT Bukalapak.com Tbk (BUKA) by 188.70 million shares, raising its stake to 10.67%, and added 1.17 million shares of PT Nitrasanata Dharma Tbk (JECX) through its health subsidiary PT Sarana Meditama Metropolitan Tbk (SAME), bringing its total shareholdings to 33%. PT Yulie Sekuritas Indonesia Tbk (YULE) raised its stake in PT Esa Medika Mandiri Tbk (EMMI) to about 10.19%; Samudra (Investment) Pte. Ltd boosted its holding in PT Mitra Adiperkasa Tbk (MAPI) to 30.19%; and Lo Kheng Hong increased his position in PT Intiland Development Tbk (DILD) to 7.54%. Edwin Soeryadjaya now controls 35.95% of PT Saratoga Investama Sedaya Tbk (SRTG), Ferry Sudjono holds roughly 6.02% of PT Fore Kopi Indonesia Tbk (FORE), while Dato Tahir reduced his stake in PT Maha Properti Indonesia Tbk (MPRO) to 10.46%. PT Global Mediacom Tbk (BMTR) sold 28.90 million shares of its subsidiary PT Media Nusantara Citra Tbk (MNCN), lowering its control to 38.23%, and The Bank of New York Mellon divested 6 million shares of PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (TLKM), retaining about 6.3% of the telecom firm.

results.title: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk (BBRI) and PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (BMRI) lead foreign net sell list as IHSG rebounds.
results.body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) rebounded on Wednesday, closing at 6,374.91, up 97.86 points (1.56%). Despite the market gain, foreign investors recorded a net sell of Rp461.35 billion across the market, with 448 stocks advancing, 186 declining and 159 unchanged. The ten stocks with the largest foreign net sell were PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk (BBRI) (Rp187.64 bn), PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (BMRI) (Rp128.73 bn), PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk (TLKM) (Rp124.67 bn), PT Indosat Tbk (ISAT) (Rp66.49 bn), PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk (ADRO) (Rp45.77 bn), PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk (BBNI) (Rp35.30 bn), PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk (CUAN) (Rp31.01 bn), PT Charoen Pokphand Indonesia Tbk (CPIN) (Rp28.87 bn), PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk (MEDC) (Rp28.27 bn), and PT AKR Corporindo Tbk (AKRA) (Rp20.33 bn). Total trading volume reached 36.09 billion shares with a transaction value of Rp12.54 trillion.

results.title: MNC Sekuritas forecasts IHSG rise and recommends top-performing stocks on 24 Sep 2026
results.body: MNC Sekuritas noted that the IHSG closed up 1.56% at 6,374.91 on 23 Sep 2026 and projected the index to test support levels 6,208-6,258 before targeting a near-term strength zone of 6,387-6,418, with support at 6,267 and 6,108 and resistance at 6,440-6,535. The LQ45 gainers were PT Indika Energy Tbk (INDY) (+10.04%), PT Darma Henwa Tbk (DEWA) (+9.20%) and PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk (MDKA) (+8.83%), with additional advances from PT Hartadinata Abadi Tbk (HRTA) (+5.99%), PT Bumi Resources Tbk (BUMI) (+4.89%) and PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk (MBMA) (+3.96%). The biggest decliners were PT Charoen Pokphand Indonesia Tbk (CPIN) (-1.91%), PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (TLKM) (-1.21%), PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk (PGAS) (-1.03%), PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) (-0.63%), PT Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk (EMTK) (-0.45%) and PT Indo Tambangraya Megah Tbk (ITMG) (-0.40%). The broker recommended buying on weakness PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk (EMAS) and PT Vktr Teknologi Mobilitas Tbk (VKTR), and buying PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk (CUAN) and PT Indika Energy Tbk (INDY).

results.title: Foreign Net Sell Surpasses Rp 100 Trillion, Keeping PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk (BBRI), PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (BMRI) and PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk (TLKM) Under Pressure
results.body: Foreign investors' net selling in the regular market reached Rp 102.9 trillion year‑to‑date, topping the Rp 100 trillion threshold and pressuring key stocks. On Wednesday, total foreign net sell across the market was Rp 460.7 billion, with the largest outflows in PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk (BBRI) at Rp 187.6 billion, PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (BMRI) at Rp 128.7 billion and PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk (TLKM) at Rp 124.6 billion. Conversely, PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk (MDKA) attracted a net foreign buy of Rp 106.7 billion and PT Timah Tbk (TINS) a net buy of Rp 53.7 billion, while the Indonesia Stock Exchange Composite Index (IHSG) closed up 97.8 points (1.5%) at 6,374.9 with total transaction value of Rp 12.8 trillion. Market commentator Hendra Wardana said the modest index gain reflected a positive reaction to Bank Indonesia’s decision to keep the BI Rate at 5.75% despite the continued foreign outflows.

results.title: IHSG drops over 1% as PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BBRI) drags the index
results.body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) fell 84.62 points, or 1.33%, to 6,300.11 on 22 September 2026, extending the decline from the previous session. The drop was led by PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BBRI), which alone pulled the index down 14.6 points, followed by PT Bayan Resources Tbk (BYAN) (-7.74 points), PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk (BRMS) (-2.98 points), PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (TLKM) (-2.77 points), PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk (BMRI) (-2.45 points), PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BBCA) (-2.21 points), PT Bumi Resources Tbk (BUMI) (-2.21 points), PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa Tbk (DSSA) (-2.15 points), PT Impack Pratama Industri Tbk (IMPC) (-2.11 points) and PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BBNI) (-1.98 points). In contrast, PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk (AMMN) added the most positive impact with +2.11 points, while PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk (MEDC) and PT Indosat Tbk (ISAT) contributed +0.38 and +0.36 points respectively. Broad sector weakness saw energy, utilities and property lead the red zone, and the market remained sensitive to domestic uncertainty over the upcoming Bank Indonesia rate decision and global oil price and geopolitical tensions.

results.title: Foreign investors net sold Rp 510.07 bn of Indonesian stocks, led by PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (BMRI)
results.body: Foreign investors recorded a net sell of Rp 510.07 bn on Monday, sending the Indonesia Composite Index (IHSG) down 0.88% to 6,384.72 points. The ten stocks with the largest foreign net outflows were PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (BMRI) (Rp 140.61 bn), PT Aneka Tambang Tbk (ANTM) (Rp 139.93 bn), PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BBCA) (Rp 131.34 bn), PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk (TLKM) (Rp 114.62 bn), PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk (MDKA) (Rp 32.42 bn), PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) (Rp 26.38 bn), PT Charoen Pokphand Indonesia Tbk (CPIN) (Rp 25.81 bn), PT Alamtri Resoruces Indonesia Tbk (ADRO) (Rp 22.32 bn), PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk (BBNI) (Rp 21.98 bn), and PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk (ENRG) (Rp 16.65 bn). Overall market activity was high, with 26.78 billion shares traded for a total value of Rp 11.77 trillion. Sectorally, infrastructure fell 1.38% while transport rose 0.55%, health gained 0.21% and property remained flat.

results.title: PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (TLKM) regains 100% ownership of PT Telkom Data Ekosistem (TDE)
results.body: PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (TLKM) completed a transaction on 17 September 2026 to acquire the remaining shares of PT Telkom Data Ekosistem (TDE), bringing its ownership to 100%. TLKM purchased 1,445,020 Series A shares and 2,015,637,361,776 Series B shares, representing 19.19% of TDE’s issued and paid‑up capital, increasing its total holding to 10,504,517,594,408 shares. PT Telkom Data Ekosistem (TDE) is a subsidiary of TLKM (99.96% owned) and previously held 0.40% by PT Sigma Cipta Caraka (Telkomsigma), which itself is a TLKM subsidiary (56.39% owned) with the remainder held by PT Multimedia Nusantara, another TLKM subsidiary (99.99% owned). The transaction was disclosed to the Indonesia Stock Exchange and reported to OJK as an affiliated transaction, following a prior Rp2.01‑trillion restructuring in August 2022 that transferred Telkomsigma’s data‑center business to TDE.

results.title: Analysts forecast IHSG weakness on Monday 21 Sep 2026 and recommend buying PT Buana Listya Tama Tbk (BULL), PT Kalbe Farma Tbk (KLBF), PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk (TLKM) and PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BBCA).
results.body: Analysts note that the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) fell 1.53% to 6,441,159 last week, reflecting pressure from higher U.S. interest‑rate expectations. BEI’s market capitalization declined 1.58% to Rp11,266 trillion, while average daily transaction value dropped 6.95% to Rp15.22 trillion and average daily volume fell 20.71% to 28.61 billion shares. MNC Sekuritas recommends investors consider a buy‑on‑weakness position in PT Buana Listya Tama Tbk (BULL), PT Kalbe Farma Tbk (KLBF) and PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk (TLKM). It also advises a buying trade for PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BBCA) as the index remains above the 6,370 support level, offering upside toward 6,541‑6,581.

results.title: PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (TLKM) acquires 100% of PT Telkom Data Ekosistem, completing full ownership after buying remaining shares from PT Sigma Cipta Caraka (Telkomsigma)
results.body: PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (TLKM) completed the purchase of the remaining 19.19% stake in PT Telkom Data Ekosistem (TDE) from PT Sigma Cipta Caraka (Telkomsigma) on 17 September 2026, resulting in TLKM holding 10,504,517,594,408 shares and 100% ownership of TDE. The transaction involved acquiring 1,445,020 Series A shares and 2,015,637,361,776 Series B shares, was disclosed in an information letter dated 18 September 2026, and TLKM stated the internal deal has no material impact on its consolidated financials and complies with applicable POJK regulations.

results.title: Caution Over Fed Sentiment as Indonesia’s Composite Index May Test 6,290 Next Week
results.body: The article warns that hawkish Fed sentiment could push the Indonesia Composite Index (IHSG) to test the 6,290‑6,370 range next week. MNC Sekuritas places the index in wave iv of wave (c) on the black label, with support at 6,279 and 6,201 and resistance at 6,585 and 6,633, and notes that staying above 6,370 could allow a rise to 6,541‑6,581. IHSG fell 1.53% to 6,441,159 on Friday, with market capitalization down 1.58% to Rp11,266 trillion, average daily transaction value down 6.95% to Rp15.22 trillion, and foreign investors net‑selling Rp1.79 trillion (cumulative Rp74.36 trillion in 2026). MNC Sekuritas recommends buying on weakness PT Buana Listya Tama Tbk (BULL), PT Kalbe Farma Tbk (KLBF) and PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk (TLKM), and a buy for PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BBCA).

results.title: Foreign investors favor PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk (BRMS), PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk (EMAS) and PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk (AADI); Top 10 Net‑Buy Stocks of the Week
results.body: During the week of 14–18 September 2026, foreign investors recorded net purchases in ten Indonesian stocks, with PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk (BRMS), PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk (EMAS) and PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk (AADI) leading the list. Net‑buy values were Rp324.7 billion for BRMS, Rp122.9 billion for EMAS, Rp115 billion for AADI, Rp92.3 billion for PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk (AMMN), Rp74.9 billion for PT Erajaya Swasembada Tbk (ERAA), Rp43.3 billion for PT Archi Indonesia Tbk (ARCI), Rp33.3 billion for PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk (PGAS), Rp30.3 billion for PT Bukit Asam Tbk (PTBA), Rp28.9 billion for PT Aneka Tambang Tbk (ANTM) and Rp22 billion for PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (TLKM). Overall foreign‑investor activity was a net sell of Rp1.84 trillion, coinciding with the IHSG index falling 1.53 % to 6,441,159, market‑capitalization decreasing 1.58 % to Rp11,266 trillion, and average daily transaction value, frequency and volume all declining. Analysts linked the market pressure to a 25‑basis‑point Fed rate hike to a 3.75‑4 % target range and expectations of further increases, which have been priced into the market.

results.title: Foreign outflow hits Rp1.79 trillion, with BBCA and BMRI leading net sells
results.body: On 18 September 2024, foreign investors recorded a net outflow of Rp1.78 trillion on the Indonesia Stock Exchange, with foreign buying rising to Rp7.04 trillion and selling to Rp8.81 trillion. The largest net‑sell positions were posted by PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BBCA) with Rp222.05 billion (35.43 million shares) and PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk (BMRI) with Rp108.93 billion (25.45 million shares), followed by PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (TLKM), PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk (AMMN) and PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BBRI). The top net‑buy positions were held by PT Aneka Tambang (Persero) Tbk (ANTM) at Rp41.09 billion (12.49 million shares), PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) at Rp22.40 billion (4.55 million shares), PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk (AADI) at Rp15.59 billion (1.27 million shares), PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk (MDKA) at Rp12.47 billion (4.28 million shares) and PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk (MBMA) at Rp10.48 billion (19.88 million shares). These figures show the breadth of foreign trading activity across major banks, telecom, mining and battery‑materials stocks.

results.title: PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk (TLKM) Acquires Remaining Shares of PT Telkom Data Ekosistem (TDE), Achieving Full Ownership
results.body: PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk (TLKM) completed the purchase of the remaining shares of its subsidiary PT Telkom Data Ekosistem (TDE), raising its ownership to 100% (10.5 trillion shares) after buying 1.44 million series A and 2.01 trillion series B shares (19.19% of TDE) from Telkomsigma. TLKM said the transaction has no material impact on its finances, reaffirmed its 2026 EBITDA‑margin target above 50% (Q1 margin 49.4% and Q2 already above target), and reported first‑half 2026 revenue of Rp75.9 trillion (up 3.9% YoY) driven by Telkomsel’s 3.3% revenue growth to Rp55.6 trillion and an EBITDA margin rise to 46.9%, with CapEx ratio at 14.2% and a full‑year guidance of 17‑19%.

results.title: Jumbo Capex by Telecom Emitters Brings Opportunities and Risks
results.body: Jumbo capex plans by Indonesian telecom issuers are set to reshape the sector, with PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk (WIFI) earmarking Rp7 trillion for 2026 to expand fixed wireless access, fiber‑to‑home, and tower fiberization. PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk (TLKM) has already spent Rp10.8 trillion in the first half of 2026, representing 14.2% of revenue, allocating 94% of capex to core B2C and B2B infrastructure and targeting a 17-19% capex‑to‑revenue ratio. PT Sarana Menara Nusantara Tbk (TOWR) plans Rp2.69 trillion for 2026, split between Rp2.01 trillion capex, Rp47 billion acquisitions, and Rp625 billion ground leases. The article highlights that while TLKM’s mature business model offers defensive growth, WIFI’s aggressive expansion carries higher execution risk and could pressure free cash flow if subscriber targets are not met, with PT Integrasi Jaringan Ekosistem (IJE) noted as a WIFI subsidiary.

results.title: PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk allocates additional 100 MHz spectrum to PT Telkomsel
results.body: PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk announced the allocation of an additional 100 MHz of spectrum to its subsidiary PT Telkomsel, expanding the latter’s 700 MHz and 2,600 MHz bands and raising its total portfolio to 265 MHz. The allocation was disclosed at the Public Expose Live 2026 TelkomGroup on 7 September 2026 to support Telkomsel’s 5G network development. In the first half of 2026 Telkomsel reported revenue of Rp28.0 trillion, up 5.3% YoY, EBITDA up 10.3%, net profit up 24.9%, and mobile ARPU of Rp46 thousand, up 11.6% YoY. The company said the new spectrum will be deployed gradually in line with market demand while maintaining investment discipline and long‑term value creation.
